name: io.github.fish827-08/kb-memory
title: kb — Local RAG Knowledge Base & Agent Memory
description: Local-first RAG knowledge base and agent memory service: ingest documents, web pages and CSV/Excel into one on-device library, with hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25 normalized fusion). Works fully offline without any LLM. Also serves as cross-session memory for Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client. Default embedding model is lightweight (bge-small-zh-v1.5, ~92 MB).
